Your journey is completely taken care of by your dedicated 3-person professional crew (Captain, Cook, and Engine Driver) who will navigate the waters and prepare fresh, authentic Kerala meals right on board.

faqs.q: Is the 1 bedroom houseboat safe for children and infants?
faqs.a: Yes, our houseboats are fully enclosed with safety rails. Please note that our crew is not specially trained for elderly assistance, and life jackets are not provided for houseboats, so please plan accordingly.

faqs.q: Can we get pure vegetarian food?
faqs.a: Yes, we prepare excellent pure vegetarian meals in a separate, clean kitchen area. Just let us know your dietary preferences when confirming your booking.

faqs.q: Are portable speakers allowed on board?
faqs.a: Yes, you are welcome to bring your own portable speakers. However, out of respect for the local village communities, we kindly request low volume after 10:00 PM.

aboutTitle: About Our Private 2 Bedroom Houseboat in Alleppey
aboutParagraphs: Designed specifically for family vacations and group trips in Kerala, our 2 bedroom houseboat in Alleppey offers the ideal blend of shared living spaces and personal privacy. With two separate air-conditioned bedrooms—each featuring its own attached washroom—it’s the perfect setup for two couples, extended families, or a small group of friends of up to 8 people (and up to 25 guests for day cruises).

Instead of booking multiple hotel rooms, stay together on the water. Bond over board games in the spacious common deck, dine together with panoramic views of the beautiful Vembanad Lake, and let our expert 3-person crew handle all the navigation and culinary duties for a truly stress-free holiday.
